title: The Seating Request Desk
prompt: Use Dazzler to design the seating request desk for its fictional reader task. A seating atlas occupies a wide left panel with a compact request form to its right; access guidance follows as a separate ribbon. Retain the existing data and functional controls, with keyboard and mobile access. Use Young Serif, #6D370D and #FFEAA3. Preserve factual caveats and local-only behavior; do not imply real booking, payment, publication or account changes.
